system.role: You are an expert onboarding assistant for the EVIE multi-agent system. Your primary goal is to collect precise user information to personalize the AI agent experience and optimize tool recommendations.
system.persona: Friendly, professional, and methodical. You guide users through the onboarding process with clear questions and helpful explanations.
guidelines: Ask one question at a time to avoid overwhelming the user
Validate user responses before proceeding to the next question
Provide clear examples when users are unsure how to answer
Store all collected information in the provided memory context
Ask for clarification if responses are ambiguous or incomplete
Adapt questions based on previous answers (e.g., skip technical questions for non-developers)
Always explain why you're asking each question and how it will improve their experience
system.tone: Conversational but professional. Use emojis sparingly (1-2 per message max).

flow.description: A step-by-step process to collect all necessary user information

steps.message:
Welcome to EVIE, your intelligent multi-agent system! I'm here to help you get started. This quick onboarding process (about 3-5 minutes) will help me understand your needs so I can provide the most relevant tools and assistance. Let's begin!

First, could you tell me your primary role?
Could you please specify your role in more detail? This will help me tailor EVIE to your specific needs.
Great! As a {{ user_profile.user_type }}, what are your technical skills? Select all that apply:

options.label: PHP
options.description: Experience with PHP development

options.label: Symfony Framework
options.description: Familiarity with Symfony 5/6/7

options.label: JavaScript/TypeScript
options.description: Frontend or Node.js development

options.label: Python
options.description: Python scripting or data science

options.label: DevOps/CI-CD
options.description: Deployment, containers, infrastructure

options.label: Databases
options.description: SQL, NoSQL, data modeling

options.label: AI/Machine Learning
options.description: Experience with AI models or ML algorithms

options.label: Cloud Services
options.description: AWS, GCP, Azure, or other cloud platforms

options.label: No technical background
options.description: I'm not technical but need AI assistance

steps.message: How would you rate your technical expertise with the skills you selected?

options.label: Beginner
options.description: Just starting out, need guidance

options.label: Intermediate
options.description: Comfortable with basics, learning advanced topics

options.label: Advanced
options.description: Very experienced, can work independently

options.label: Expert
options.description: Deep expertise, can mentor others

steps.message: What are your primary use cases for EVIE? Select all that apply:

options.label: Code Generation
options.description: Generate PHP, JavaScript, or other code

options.label: Code Review
options.description: Review and suggest improvements for existing code

options.label: Business Process Automation
options.description: Automate repetitive business tasks

options.label: Data Analysis & Visualization
options.description: Analyze datasets and create visualizations

options.label: Document Processing
options.description: Extract, summarize, or transform documents

options.label: Research & Information Gathering
options.description: Gather and synthesize information from various sources

options.label: Project Management
options.description: Assist with planning, tracking, and coordinating projects

options.label: System Administration
options.description: Help with server, deployment, or infrastructure tasks

options.label: Learning & Education
options.description: Explain concepts, provide tutorials, or help learn new skills

options.label: Other Use Case
options.description: Something not listed above

steps.message: Could you describe your specific use case in more detail?
Which industry or domain do you primarily work in?

options.label: Technology/Software
options.description: Software development, IT services, etc.

options.label: Gastronomy/Hospitality
options.description: Restaurants, hotels, catering (special EVIE focus)

options.label: Retail/E-commerce
options.description: Online stores, physical retail

options.label: Finance/Accounting
options.description: Banking, accounting, financial services

options.label: Healthcare
options.description: Hospitals, clinics, medical services

options.label: Education
options.description: Schools, universities, training

options.label: Manufacturing/Logistics
options.description: Production, supply chain, logistics

options.label: Non-profit/NGO
options.description: Charities, foundations, non-governmental organizations

options.label: Other Industry
options.description: An industry not listed above

steps.message: How do you prefer to receive responses from EVIE?

options.label: Concise
options.description: Short, direct answers with minimal explanation

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Detailed but to the point, with relevant explanations

options.label: Detailed
options.description: Comprehensive answers with step-by-step explanations and examples

options.label: Context-Dependent
options.description: Let EVIE decide based on the situation

steps.message: How technical should the responses be?

options.label: Non-Technical
options.description: Avoid technical jargon, explain in simple terms

options.label: Somewhat Technical
options.description: Use some technical terms but explain them

options.label: Technical
options.description: Use technical terms freely, assume knowledge

options.label: Highly Technical
options.description: Deep technical details, code examples, architecture discussions

steps.message: What language do you prefer for communication with EVIE?

options.label: German
options.description: Deutsch

options.label: English
options.description: English

options.label: Both
options.description: Respond in the same language as my input

steps.message: How would you like to be notified about important updates or approvals?

options.label: Email
options.description: Send notifications to my email

options.label: In-App Notifications
options.description: Show notifications in the EVIE interface

options.label: Slack
options.description: Send messages to my Slack workspace

options.label: Microsoft Teams
options.description: Send messages to my Teams channel

options.label: No Notifications
options.description: Do not send any notifications

steps.message: For which types of actions should EVIE request Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval?
steps.description: HITL means a human must explicitly approve the action before it's executed.

options.label: Database Modifications
options.description: Any changes to databases (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)

options.label: File System Changes
options.description: Creating, modifying, or deleting files

options.label: External API Calls
options.description: Calls to external services or APIs

options.label: New Tool Creation
options.description: When EVIE wants to create a new tool

options.label: High-Cost Operations
options.description: Actions that may incur significant costs (API calls, computations)

options.label: No HITL Required
options.description: Trust EVIE to make decisions without approval

steps.message: What security level would you like for your EVIE instance?
steps.description: This affects which tools are available and what actions they can perform.

options.label: Restricted
options.description: Only basic, safe operations. Most tools disabled.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Good security with most tools available. Recommended for most users.

options.label: Permissive
options.description: Most tools enabled, but with HITL approval for sensitive operations.

options.label: Custom
options.description: I'll configure security settings manually later.

steps.message: Thank you! Here's a summary of your preferences. Please review and confirm:
What would you like to correct? Please specify which information is incorrect and what the correct value should be.

Perfect! Your onboarding is complete. EVIE is now configured to provide the best possible experience for your needs.

## What's Next?

1. **Explore Available Tools:** Check out the tool catalog to see what EVIE can do
2. **Try the Orchestrator:** Ask EVIE a question to see how it delegates to sub-agents
3. **Customize Further:** Adjust your preferences anytime in the settings

## Quick Start Commands

- `List all available tools`: `/tools list`
- `Show my profile`: `/profile show`
- `Start a conversation`: Just type your question!

Thank you for choosing EVIE. Type `/help` at any time for assistance.

error_handling.invalid_input: I'm sorry, that doesn't seem to be a valid answer. {{ error_message }} Please try again.
error_handling.validation_failed: The answer doesn't meet the requirements: {{ error_message }}. Please provide a valid response.
error_handling.timeout: It seems you're taking a while to respond. You can take your time, or type 'skip' to move to the next question.
error_handling.interruption: No problem! We can continue the onboarding later. Your progress has been saved. Type '/onboarding resume' to continue.
